exercise.name: Air Bike
library_steps: Set the seat so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom.
Pedal and push-pull the handles together at a steady, hard effort.
Ease off and pedal slowly for a minute before you stop.
exercise.one_line_summary: Seated on the air bike pedalling and pushing/pulling the moving handles. Picture 1: left pedal top, left arm pushed forward, right arm pulled back; picture 2: the other way round.

setup.target: Saddle height so the knee is bent ~25-35 deg at the bottom of the stroke.
Leaning forward ~15-20 deg to the bar.
Hands on the moving handles, palms in.

movement.start: forward arm elbow ~22 deg; back arm elbow ~95 deg

muscles.role: Library primary 'cardio' has no mask; front thigh lit (library secondary).

muscles.emg: Anterior deltoid drives the arm push (S3).

muscles.role: Push phase of the arms (S3); not lit to keep the picture simple.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Legs stop while the arms work.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Legs do most of the work (S1).

sources.citation: Hug F, Dorel S. Electromyographic analysis of pedaling: a review. J Electromyogr Kinesiol. 2009;19(2):182-198.
sources.what_it_gave: Pedalling EMG: vastii and gluteus maximus drive the down-stroke, hamstrings the bottom/back, gastrocnemius transfers force at the ankle.

sources.citation: Bini R, Hume PA, Croft JL. Effects of bicycle saddle height on knee injury risk and cycling performance. Sports Med. 2011;41(6):463-476.
sources.what_it_gave: Saddle set so the knee is bent ~25-35 deg at the bottom of the pedal stroke.

sources.citation: Smith PM, Chapman ML, Hazlehurst KE, Goss-Sampson MA. The influence of crank configuration on muscle activity and torque production during arm crank ergometry. J Electromyogr Kinesiol. 2008;18(4):598-605.
sources.what_it_gave: Arm cranking: anterior deltoid, triceps and biceps activity through the push and pull phases.

clip_check.target: forward arm elbow ~22 deg; back arm elbow ~95 deg -> (swapped) (visual)

clip_check.check: Machine parts meet the hands/feet; levers keep their length
clip_check.target: moving rod lengths equal at start and end (+-1 cm)
